task_instruction: Update `res://assets/tile_set.tres` to add a terrain set for the half-offset square tileset. Create a terrain set in Match Corners mode with a single terrain named `Path`; the terrain set uses the dirt path tiles against grass default. Configure all terrain peer bits correctly so all the 15 path tiles autotile properly (include grass as default and ignore the bordered path tile in the tileset, which should be unused in this autotile). Do not change the existing tile shape or other metadata.
local_official_message: TileSet must define a terrain set
solver_diff:
--- original/tmp_example.tres
+++ solver/tmp_example.tres
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+[gd_resource type="TileSet" load_steps=3 format=3]
+
+[ext_resource type="Texture2D" path="res://assets/sprites/tile_iso.png" id="1_ogu76"]
+
+[sub_resource type="TileSetAtlasSource" id="TileSetAtlasSource_3ibdd"]
+texture = ExtResource("1_ogu76")
+texture_region_size = Vector2i(45, 20)
+0:0/0 = 0
+0:0/0/terrain_set = 0
+0:0/0/terrain = 0
+0:0/0/terrains_peering_bit/bottom_right_corner = 0
+0:0/0/terrains_peering_bit/bottom_corner = 0
+0:0/0/terrains_peering_bit/bottom_left_corner = 0
+0:0/0/terrains_peering_bit/top_left_corner = 0
+0:0/0/terrains_peering_bit/top_corner = 0
+0:0/0/terrains_peering_bit/top_right_corner = 0
+
+[resource]
+tile_shape = 2
+tile_size = Vector2i(28, 18)
+terrain_set_0/mode = 1
+terrain_set_0/terrain_0/name = "Path"
+terrain_set_0/terrain_0/color = Color(0.5, 0.34375, 0.25, 1)
+sources/1 = SubResource("TileSetAtlasSource_3ibdd")

--- original/tmp_inspect.gd
+++ solver/tmp_inspect.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+extends SceneTree
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	print("MATCH_CORNERS=", TileSet.TERRAIN_MODE_MATCH_CORNERS)
+	for constant in ClassDB.class_get_integer_constant_list("TileSet"):
+		if "CORNER" in constant or "SIDE" in constant or "TERRAIN" in constant:
+			print(constant, "=", ClassDB.class_get_integer_constant("TileSet", constant))
+	var tile_set := TileSet.new()
+	tile_set.tile_shape = TileSet.TILE_SHAPE_HALF_OFFSET_SQUARE
+	tile_set.tile_size = Vector2i(28, 18)
+	tile_set.add_terrain_set()
+	tile_set.set_terrain_set_mode(0, TileSet.TERRAIN_MODE_MATCH_CORNERS)
+	tile_set.add_terrain(0)
+	tile_set.set_terrain_name(0, 0, "Path")
+	var atlas := TileSetAtlasSource.new()
+	atlas.texture = load("res://assets/sprites/tile_iso.png")
+	atlas.texture_region_size = Vector2i(45, 20)
+	tile_set.add_source(atlas, 1)
+	atlas.create_tile(Vector2i.ZERO)
+	var data := atlas.get_tile_data(Vector2i.ZERO, 0)
+	data.terrain_set = 0
+	data.terrain = 0
+	for bit in range(16):
+		if data.is_valid_terrain_peering_bit(bit):
+			print("VALID BIT: ", bit)
+			data.set_terrain_peering_bit(bit, 0)
+	ResourceSaver.save(tile_set, "res://tmp_example.tres")
+	for method in tile_set.get_method_list():
+		var name: String = method["name"]
+		if "terrain" in name or "source" in name:
+			print(name)
+	quit()
